refreshNotes:
Carryover year within the 6th-gen CR-V (2023+). Three hybrid trims: Sport Hybrid (FWD or AWD), Sport-L (AWD), and Sport Touring Hybrid (AWD-only). Two-motor e:HEV system (2.0L + two motors, 204 hp). EPA: 43/36/40 city/hwy/combined (FWD Sport) and 40/34/37 (AWD trims). Honda Sensing safety suite standard, 9-inch touchscreen on Sport Touring.

Sources:
- https://www.edmunds.com/honda/cr-v/2025/hybrid/
- https://www.kbb.com/honda/cr-v-hybrid/2025/specs/
